content:
Update `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml` to add prod-only patches. Keep `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` untouched.

Use patches like this pattern in `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../clusters
  - ../../infra

patches:
  # 1) App replicas: 2 -> 4
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: app
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 4

  # 2) RDS instance class: db.t3.micro -> db.t3.medium
  # 3) Enable multi-AZ
  - target:
      kind: DBInstance
      name: app-db
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/dbInstanceClass
        value: db.t3.medium
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/multiAz
        value: true

  # 4) S3 cross-region replication to us-west-2
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: app-assets
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/replicationConfiguration
        value:
          role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/s3-replication-role
          rules:
            - status: Enabled
              destination:
                bucket: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-replica
                storageClass: STANDARD
              filter: {}
```

Notes:
- This changes only the prod overlay.
- Dev remains unchanged because patches live only in `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`.
- If your actual resource names/kinds differ (`app`, `app-db`, `app-assets`), replace the `target.name`/`kind` values accordingly.
- If your repo uses strategic merge instead of inline JSON6902, that is also valid, but this inline `patches` form is the simplest while still only touching the prod kustomization.
